messages.text: Your cookware set is marked as shipped, not delivered, so it can’t be refunded through this process yet. Refunds are for delivered orders; cancelling or changing delivery is outside this process (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). If you’d like, I can connect you with a staff member to ask about cancelling the order.
